ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning DC Generators, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for DC Generators.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after DC Generators.
   C. Skip safety briefings for DC Generators.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for DC Generators.

2. When learning Single Phase AC Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Single Phase AC Circuits.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Single Phase AC Circuits.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Single Phase AC Circuits.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Single Phase AC Circuits.

3. When learning Electrical Diagrams, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Diagrams.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Diagrams.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Diagrams.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Diagrams.

4. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Keyboard

5. When learning Power Supplies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Power Supplies.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Power Supplies.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Power Supplies.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Power Supplies.

6. When learning Wiring Systems and Regulations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Wiring Systems and Regulations.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wiring Systems and Regulations.

7. When learning Inspection and Testing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Inspection and Testing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Inspection and Testing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Inspection and Testing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Inspection and Testing.

8. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Run with the tool

9. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. International Cricket Team

10. When learning Earthing and Excess Current Protection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Earthing and Excess Current Protection.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Earthing and Excess Current Protection.

11. When learning Electronics 4.4 Project Identification, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electronics 4.4 Project Identification.

12. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Projection.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Projection.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Projection.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Digital Electronics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Single Phase AC Circuits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Orthographic Projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Electrical Diagrams and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
